slides.title: What's special?
slides.body: OLMoE showed that a sparse MoE with only ~1B active parameters can match much larger dense models — and released everything: weights, data, training code, and router analyses. Expert sparsity is exactly what makes streaming-from-disk viable: only the routed experts need to be resident in memory for each token.
bullets: MoE = more parameters without paying the full dense FLOPs cost
Router decisions determine which expert weights must be loaded
Open MoE releases unlock systems research (caching, prefetch, SSD tiering)

slides.title: Inside the model
slides.body: Mixture-of-Experts transformer: dense attention + MoE MLP blocks with 64 experts/layer and top-8 routing (~1B active / ~7B total params). Because most experts are idle on any given token, expert placement and caching are useful systems-research questions.

flow.caption: The router chooses a small team of experts for each token, then merges their work.

steps.label: Experts

slides.title: One token through the experts
slides.body: Follow a single generated token: the router picks specialists, those experts run, then logits become the next piece of text.
bullets: Most parameters stay idle; only routed experts burn FLOPs
That is why MoE can feel 'bigger than it runs'
Systems work (batching, expert placement) matters as much as the paper math

slides.title: Talk to the local server
slides.body: After Serve shows running, the notebook uses the same OpenAI-compatible API that Chat uses — no cloud round-trip.
slides.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8100/v1",
    api_key="local",  # ignored by max serve
)
stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Explain this model in one sentence."}],
    stream=True,
    max_tokens=64,
)
for event in stream:
    delta = event.choices[0].delta.content or ""
    print(delta, end="", flush=True)

steps.text: base_url is mxstudio's max serve port (8100).

steps.text: Use the Hugging Face id as the model name.
